interpretation.shared_pattern: Both methods reduced internal false positives by making the classifier more conservative, but both also reduced malignant recall and failed to improve external BUSI AUC.
interpretation.engineering_read: The bottleneck is unlikely to be solved by stronger separation losses alone. The remaining issue looks more like calibration / cross-domain probability bias than insufficient feature discrimination.
interpretation.next_best_direction: Try post-hoc calibration or learnable logit/bias correction before another structural loss sweep.
